title: PRD lockstep onboarding and contractual acceptance flow
creator: Marco Chen
description: Goal: Define a deterministic, cross-team acceptance flow for new PRDs that require contractual updates (data residency / SLAs) so that engineering, design, and legal signoffs are executed in lockstep and handoffs are unambiguous. Scope: onboarding flow for features that change customer-facing contracts or data residency (Private/VPC and Dedicated). Out of scope: routine UI-only copy updates and internal infra refactors that do not affect contracts. Context: multiple recent PRDs stalled because legal signoff arrived after engineering completed an irreversible migration step; we need an acceptance corridor with explicit gating, rollback triggers, and a minimal checklist each team can verify.
acceptance_criteria: A consolidated PRD checklist exists and is linked from the PRD: product requirements, risk matrix, contract change summary, data residency impact statement
Design approval recorded with annotated frames (Figma) and UX test artifacts for any customer-visible change
Engineering provides a migration/rollback plan with guardrails and a deploy gating ticket that references required legal clauses
Legal publishes a one-page contract delta that clearly documents required SLA or residency changes and an explicit approval token for engineering to proceed
A single 'go/no-go' owner is identified per PRD (product) and documented in the PRD header
Telemetry & observability acceptance criteria defined and a dashboard created; smoke test plan with pass/fail thresholds included
If contractual change affects existing customers, a communication plan and customer opt-out path are drafted
All signoffs are recorded as comments in this Linear ticket and exported to Confluence for audit purposes
